displayName: Recorded Future SCF - Potentially Abused Domains
note: Recorded Future Security Control Feeds - Potentially Abused Domains (Ingress)

params.label: ThreatConnect Owner
params.name: tc_owner
params.note: The destination Owner in the ThreatConnect Platform.

params.label: Recorded Future API Token
params.name: rf_api_token
params.note: The API token for the Recorded Future API.

params.label: ThreatConnect Confidence
params.name: tc_confidence
params.note: The confidence level of the indicators.

params.label: ThreatConnect Threat Rating
params.name: tc_threat_rating
params.note: The threat rating of the indicators.

params.label: Batch Limit
params.name: batch_limit
params.note: Maximum number of pages (~10,000 records per page) to process in either mode (empty since_date backfill or populated since_date incremental).

params.label: Since Date (Last Run Cursor)
params.name: since_date
params.note: Mode selector. If empty, run starts from newest records (initial/backfill behavior). If populated, only records with timestamp after this date are imported (ISO datetime or date, e.g. 2025-01-15T00:00:00Z or 2025-01-15).
